baseline.working_tree: Dirty working tree with existing tracked and untracked work; file hashes identify the read authoring snapshot, not a release.

limitations: At initial question authoring, working-tree source indexes and runtime retrieval catalog could not be read due to filesystem permissions. Coverage used all 58 readable on-disk answer cards and six readable route files; declaration membership and runtime assembly were not verified in that authoring step.

Coverage means authored questions reference a task/aspect/document, not complete source-chunk, alias or policy coverage. Source content, applicability and publication must be independently reviewed before any execution acceptance.
Question scenarios have not been executed through an API, model, database or test runner. No automatic grading or live quality evaluation is established by authoring or Git-policy checks.
Runtime recognition of paraphrases, spelling variants, safety prompts and ambiguity scenarios is unverified; expectations are review criteria, not claims of passing behavior.

The Git allowlist now permits README.md, index.json and direct JSON children of the six question groups. The inventory checker only permits indexed group files as nonruntime sources; it does not grade cases or add them to runtime manifests. Root-level reports, backup extensions and unknown/nested paths remain ignored; an unlisted group JSON is rejected once tracked. No staging, commit or push is performed automatically.
